change: Store maximum eligible alignment score per query/taxon, instead of every redundant accession alignment. A taxon meets the existing near-best threshold iff its maximum score meets it. Scientific thresholds, reference, and search parameters unchanged.
synthetic_parity: 10001alignments/52pairs in three orders, covering min length, threshold equality, repeated taxa, higher later scores, missing taxonomy, mixed kingdoms, one/two mates, and absent alignments.
scope: Pending NR summary and baseline-control summary. The original implementation is retained for independent comparison.
